steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Mercenaries?

options: Right. Not for the inheritance, but to save you.

steps.content: You've decided to borrow the identity of the mercenary named 99.

options: You just broke out of the MBCC, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hmph, what if I did?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You didn't return to the Legion, so Zoya sent a lot of people out to look for you. We're only part of the effort.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Why you?

options: There's a sort of friendship between us and the SALVA.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Only yesterday, together with Iron and Anne, we defeated Ted. It's then that we learned the news about you.
Horo stares at you, seemingly looking into her own memories, but she does not loosen her grip on the ax.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: You said it's my boss who sent you here to save me... Where is she then?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: She would either believe in me and wait in the fleet for my triumphant return, or lead by example and come to the battlefield herself.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: She would certainly not entrust her important subordinate to some dodgy characters.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I've been guarding this place for a long time. The only visitors have been those animals from the gangs. Don't you try to deceive me!
Boom... From the other end of the pit comes continuous booming and vibration that penetrate the thick walls. It's Zoya... She is drawing near. You can't stall any longer.
The surrounding contamination is approaching and starts metamorphosing. But Horo pays no heed, her gaze fixed on you.
This is a look of great determination; she has absolute trust in someone and is willing to burn everything down for that trust. This determination can be taken advantage of...

options: Yeah, she came down there long ago to save you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She asked us to stay up here, and she went down by the central elevator and went into the depths of the contamination to save you.
You point in Zoya's direction casually. As if on cue, vibrations issue from there.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: What are you talking about? The central elevator is full of traps. My boss she...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yeah, Zoya didn't return at the agreed time. The influence of the inheritance was greater than anyone had thought.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Your advisor, that Earl guy, he was concerned, so he paid us extra to come down here and lend a hand.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Zoya ordered in no uncertain terms that no Legion member shall follow her here, but we are just some lowly mercenaries. We "questioned" a couple of gangsters, found the secret elevator, and came down there... As simple as that.
Upon hearing the name Earl, Horo looks bemused for a second. Her furious desire to fight seems to cool drastically, and her face takes on a complex expression.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...It's Earl who sent you? Because he's... concerned?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...That bastard! Who needs his concern?
She leaps up, and comes at you, wielding her ax. Just one blow, and the contaminated Corruptor behind you is cut in half.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I believe you. Outsiders only know that Zoya is with the Legion, but you guys have met Earl. You are telling the truth.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'll make up for roughing you up. Let me deal with this bunch of monsters first, and then you can take it out on me!
